# All Factored · แยกหมดแล้ว

> Why the locks on the internet are changing, as touchable pictures. Thai first, English toggle.

- Mixing paint: two cans mix at once; unmixing means trying pairs.
- Seat the guests: 221 guests, equal tables; try each table size until one fits (13 × 17).
- The mail slot: anyone drops a letter in; only the key holder opens the box (public and private keys).
- Flashlight and floodlight: one guest at a time versus the whole room, where every 17th guest lines up in stripes (how a quantum computer finds the pattern).
- The freezer: copy now, open later; Mosca's x + y > z.
- The new lock: a dining room with a good map and a bad map (lattices, ML-KEM).
- Our shopfront, checked 28 Sep 2026: door lock X25519MLKEM768 on motdang.net, hongdam.net, wichaa.net, nanobotco.github.io; licence (certificate) still ECDSA/RSA.

Cites: Shor 1994; Gidney 2025; NIST FIPS 203; NCSC PQC timelines; Mosca 2018; ChainsAtlas whitepaper; Red Team Partners partner programme.
